configurationFields.label: IWAD Path
configurationFields.description: Sets the path to the DOOM II IWAD file to use. 'Default' assumes that GSCS manages the download from Steam of the client files. If that is disabled under Updates, select 'Custom' and specify Custom IWAD Path accordingly

configurationFields.label: Custom IWAD Path
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom path to use for the IWAD Path, if 'Custom' is selected

configurationFields.label: Load Files
configurationFields.description: Sets a space-separated list of files to load with the server. The files can be WAD, PK3, PK7, ZIP, 7z, BEX, BEH, DEH or CLD files

configurationFields.label: Server Hostname
configurationFields.description: Sets the display name the server has on the master server list

configurationFields.label: Force Join Password
configurationFields.description: If set, clients must supply the Join Password in order to join the gam. Clients without the proper join password may still spectate freely

configurationFields.label: Join Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the join password clients must supply in order to join the game, if Force Join Password is enabled

configurationFields.label: Force Server Password
configurationFields.description: If set, clients must supply the Server Password in order to connect to the server. Clients without the proper password may not connect at all

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password clients must supply to connect to the server, if Force Server Password is enabled

configurationFields.label: Host Email
configurationFields.description: Sets an e-mail address for clients to send an email to the administrator of the server

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets a message of the day (MOTD) on the server, a welcome message printed on clients upon connection

configurationFields.label: Server Website
configurationFields.description: Sets a website for the server. Used as the primary download location for any PWADs

configurationFields.label: Client Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of clients (players and spectators) that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that can join the game at one time. Others clients will be forced to spectate

configurationFields.label: Client Limit Per IP
configurationFields.description: Sets how many clients with the same IP can enter the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Admin List
configurationFields.description: List of IPs of clients who are considered to be administrators on the server. Administrators can bypass the Client Limit and cannot be votekicked

configurationFields.label: Ban Exemption (Whitelist) Files
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon seaprated list of files that define a whitelist of IPs that are exempt from bans and votekicks

configurationFields.label: Ban Files
configurationFields.description: Semi-colon seaprated list of files that define a blacklist of banned IPs

configurationFields.label: AFK To Spectator Time
configurationFields.description: Inactive (AFK) players will be forced to spectators after the specified time period. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Air Control
configurationFields.description: Sets the [control](https://wiki.zandronum.com/Air_Control) a player has over their direction while in the air

configurationFields.label: Allow ACS Ban Function
configurationFields.description: If set, allows mods to ban players using the [BanFromGame](https://wiki.zandronum.com/BanFromGame) ACS function. Requires development version 3.2-alpha and above

configurationFields.label: Allow Private Chat
configurationFields.description: Determines if clients are allowed to send private messages to each other or the host of the server

configurationFields.label: Allow Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: Controls whether voice chat is enabled and who can use it. Requires development version 3.2-alpha and above

configurationFields.label: Proximity Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, enables proximity-based voice chat. Requires development version 3.2-alpha and above

configurationFields.label: Maximum Proximity Rolloff Distance
configurationFields.description: Controls the distance at which proximity voice chat is no longer audible. Requires development version 3.2-alpha and above

configurationFields.label: Minimum Proximity Rolloff Distance
configurationFields.description: Controls the distance at which proximity voice chat will begin rolling off (becoming quieter). Requires development version 3.2-alpha and above

configurationFields.label: Broadcast To LAN
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will broadcast to the local area network

configurationFields.label: Enable Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, clients can use cheat commands on the server. Use with care!

configurationFields.label: Coop Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage multiplier applied to all damage players receive from monsters

configurationFields.label: Coop Spawn Voodoo Dolls
configurationFields.description: If set, [Voodoo dolls](https://doomwiki.org/wiki/Voodoo_doll) will be supported online

configurationFields.label: Coop Unassigned Voodoo Dolls
configurationFields.description: If set, all voodoo dolls are spawned when the map is loaded, regardless of whether the corresponding player is in the server. Dolls will also not be assigned to any player

configurationFields.label: Coop Unassigned Voodoo Dolls For Specified Players
configurationFields.description: Controls how many players a voodoo doll caters for. Dolls are spawned for players 1 to the number specified

configurationFields.label: Server Country
configurationFields.description: Sets the country of the server as shown in server browsers (though not all browsers support this feature). Use an [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3), 'automatic', or 'unknown'

configurationFields.label: Default DM Flags
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will automatically set certain dmflags for certain game modes. In coop they will be cleared

configurationFields.label: Disable Auto Health
configurationFields.description: If set, disables auto-triggering of certain health items for Heretic, Hexen, and Strife

configurationFields.label: Disallow Spying
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents clients from spying on other players

configurationFields.label: Disallow Suicide
configurationFields.description: If set, players cannot kill themselves with the Z kill command

configurationFields.label: Disable Kill
configurationFields.description: If set, players may not Z kill themselves

configurationFields.label: Drop Style
configurationFields.description: Controls the style for how items from monsters are dropped on the floor

configurationFields.label: Enforce Bans
configurationFields.description: If set, the banlist will be actually enforced

configurationFields.label: Enforce Master Banlist
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will enforce the master server's banlist

configurationFields.label: Fast Weapons
configurationFields.description: Sets how fast weapons fire

configurationFields.label: Gravity
configurationFields.description: Sets how strong gravity is present in the game world. Higher values create stronger gravity

configurationFields.label: Prevent Player Item Drops
configurationFields.description: If set, players may not drop items. Items may never be dropped in duels

configurationFields.label: Limit Commands
configurationFields.description: If set, enables client commands flooding protection

configurationFields.label: Enable Log File Append
configurationFields.description: If set, and a logfile with the same name is present, the server will add to the log file instead of overwriting

configurationFields.label: Enable Log File Name Timestamp
configurationFields.description: If set, when generating a new log file, the server will append the time and date to the end of the logfile name

configurationFields.label: Enable Log File Timestamp
configurationFields.description: If set, the server logfile is written containing time stamps at every new line

configurationFields.label: Log File Timestamp Use Date
configurationFields.description: If set, the current date will be prepended to the per-line timestamp of the logfile

configurationFields.label: Measure Outbound Traffic
configurationFields.description: If set, the server measures how much bandwidth is used for both ACS scripts and actor classes. The result can be printed with the command 'dumptrafficmeasure'

configurationFields.label: Mark Chat Lines
configurationFields.description: If set, all chat messages within the server console contain a 'CHAT' tag before the typed message

configurationFields.label: Maximum Packet Size
configurationFields.description: Sets how much data can be stored in a UDP packet

configurationFields.label: Use Map Settings Possession Hold Time
configurationFields.description: If set, the hold time set in a map definition takes precedence over sv_possessionholdtime

configurationFields.label: Enable Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If set, the server uses an authentication mechanism to ensure clients have the correct WADs

configurationFields.label: Master Server Query Timer
configurationFields.description: Flood throttle for server browser queries

configurationFields.label: Enable Random Coop Starts
configurationFields.description: If set, in cooperative game modes, players will be spawned at random player starts

configurationFields.label: Enable Map Rotation
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will use a map rotation list to determine the campaign

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Sets the map rotation list. Format: addmap <mapname>. One line per map. Requires Map Rotation to be enabled. Will be overridden if Random Map Rotation is enabled
configurationFields.default: ["addmap MAP01","addmap MAP02","addmap MAP03","addmap MAP04","addmap MAP05","addmap MAP06","addmap MAP07","addmap MAP08","addmap MAP09","addmap MAP10","addmap MAP11","addmap MAP12","addmap MAP13","addmap MAP14","addmap MAP15","addmap MAP16","addmap MAP17","addmap MAP18","addmap MAP19","addmap MAP20","addmap MAP21","addmap MAP22","addmap MAP23","addmap MAP24","addmap MAP25","addmap MAP26","addmap MAP27","addmap MAP28","addmap MAP29","addmap MAP30","addmap MAP31"]

configurationFields.label: Enable Random Map Rotation
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will randomize the map rotation list instead of advancing through maps in sequence. Requires Map Rotation to be enabled

configurationFields.label: Respawn Delay Time
configurationFields.description: Sets how long a player must wait after dying before they can respawn

configurationFields.label: Show Launcher Queries
configurationFields.description: If set, displays the IPs of clients querying the server (for debugging)

configurationFields.label: Show Warnings
configurationFields.description: If set, shows certain warning messages (for debugging)

configurationFields.label: Enable Console Timestamp
configurationFields.description: If set, the server console will contain a timestamp for all messages

configurationFields.label: Timestamp Format
configurationFields.description: Sets the format for console timestamps

configurationFields.label: Smart Aim Mode
configurationFields.description: Affects the behaviour of auto-aiming

configurationFields.label: Smooth Players
configurationFields.description: Enables the skip correction which tries to smooth the movement of lagging players. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Sudden Death
configurationFields.description: If set, when the time limit is hit and all teams have the same score, sudden death commences. The first team to score wins

configurationFields.label: Survival Countdown Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the warm-up duration in survival games

configurationFields.label: Allow Unlimited Pickup
configurationFields.description: If set, allows players to pickup ammunition past maximum amounts

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will identify itself to the master server and will be broadcasted in the server list

configurationFields.label: Use Tic Buffering
configurationFields.description: If set, instead of processing all commands of a client immediately, they are stored in a 'ticbuffer', and processed up to two sets per server tic. Changeable on experimental builds only

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional [command line arguments](https://wiki.zandronum.com/Command-line_parameters) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Minimum Voters
configurationFields.description: Sets how many players are needed in the server in order to call a vote

configurationFields.label: Vote Cooldown
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown between votes. 0 = cooldown disabled

configurationFields.label: Voting Mode
configurationFields.description: Manages how votes take place

configurationFields.label: No Change Map Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all Z changemap votes. However, map votes may still be called unless No Map Vote is set

configurationFields.label: No Duel Limit Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to change the duel limit

configurationFields.label: No DMFlag Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all DMFlag votes

configurationFields.label: No Force Spec Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to force players to Spec by voting

configurationFields.label: No Frag Limit Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to change the frag limit

configurationFields.label: No Kick Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to kick players

configurationFields.label: No Map Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all Z map votes. However, changemap votes may still be called unless No Change Map Vote is set

configurationFields.label: No Next Map Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all Z nextmap votes. However, nextsecret votes may still be called unless No Next Secret Vote is set

configurationFields.label: No Next Secret Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all Z nextsecret votes

configurationFields.label: No Point Limit Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to change the point limit

configurationFields.label: No Time Limit Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to change the time limit

configurationFields.label: No Win Limit Vote
configurationFields.description: If set, disables all votes to change the LMS win limit

configurationFields.label: Server Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [2 or 3 digit version number](https://zandronum.com/downloads/) for a specific server version to install. Empty = latest version. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Disable DOOM II Download
configurationFields.description: If set, DOOM II client files (Steam App ID 2280) will not be downloaded from Steam when the server is updated. The DOOM II IWAD file must be provided manually, and the IWAD Path set accordingly

deploymentSteps.name: Zandronum Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path 'server'; $ServerVersion='{SERVERVERSION}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ServerVersion)) { $ServerVersion = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://zandronum.com/downloads/').Links.href | Where-Object { $_ -match 'zandronum([\d\.]+)-win64-base\.zip'} | ForEach-Object { $Matches[1] } | Sort-Object { [version]$_ } | Select-Object -Last 1 }; if ($ServerVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?$') { Write-Output \"Invalid Zandronum version format specified\"; exit 1 }; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://zandronum.com/downloads/zandronum${ServerVersion}-win64-base.zip -OutFile 'zandronum.zip'; if ($?) { Expand-Archive -Path 'zandronum.zip' -DestinationPath '.' -Force *> $null; if (Test-Path zandronum.zip) { Remove-Item -Path 'zandronum.zip' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }; Write-Output \"Zandronum v$ServerVersion downloaded\" }"
